--!strict -- Every kind of token, to see the colors by local count: number = 0 local name = "Avatar\n"
local function half(n: number): number return n / 2 end
LLEvents.touch_start = function(detected) ll.Say(PUBLIC_CHANNEL, `Hello {name}`) for i = 1, #detected do count += 1 end if count > 3 then LLTimers:once(half(count), function() ll.OwnerSay(tostring(math.pi)) end) end end

combo_box.name: theme
combo_box.tool_tip: A set of colors for every part of the editor; Custom is whatever the swatches say

button.label: Save As...
button.name: save_theme
button.tool_tip: The colors as they stand, kept as a theme of your own

button.label: Skin Colors
button.name: restore_skin
button.tool_tip: Every color back to what the skin declares

font_field.name: font
font_field.tool_tip: The editors' font, shown in itself; click to pick the face, the size and the style against a sample

code_editor.name: preview
code_editor.tool_tip: How the editors will look; type here freely, nothing is kept

panel.label: Editor
panel.name: editor_tab

spinner.name: tab_width
spinner.tool_tip: How many columns apart the tab stops are, and how far a level of indentation goes

check_box.label: Indent with spaces rather than tabs
check_box.name: insert_spaces
check_box.tool_tip: Tab, a new line and the formatter put spaces to the next stop in; off, a tab character

check_box.label: Close brackets and quotes as they are typed
check_box.name: auto_close
check_box.tool_tip: An opening bracket or quote gets its closer, typed over when it is reached; a selection is wrapped in the pair; one Backspace between an empty pair takes both

check_box.label: Suggest completions as a name is typed
check_box.name: auto_complete
check_box.tool_tip: The list of what could go here opens on its own; off, it opens only when asked for (Control-Space)

spinner.name: complete_after
spinner.tool_tip: How many letters of a name are typed before the list opens on its own

check_box.label: Return takes the chosen completion (Tab always does)
check_box.name: accept_on_enter
check_box.tool_tip: Off, Return starts a new line and closes the list, and only Tab takes a completion

panel.text: Blank lines kept in a row:

spinner.name: blank_lines
spinner.tool_tip: How many blank lines in a row formatting leaves; more are taken out

check_box.label: Set the spaces within lines, not only the indentation
check_box.name: format_spacing
check_box.tool_tip: Formatting puts one space around operators and after commas; off, it indents and leaves the rest of each line as written

check_box.label: Open scripts in Script Studio, not the old editor
check_box.name: studio_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: A script opened from inventory, an object's contents or the build tool opens here; off, the old script editor opens it, for one more release

combo_box.name: caret_style
combo_box.tool_tip: How the caret is drawn; vim's normal mode draws a block whatever this says

check_box.label: Blink
check_box.name: caret_blink
check_box.tool_tip: Off, the caret stays lit

check_box.label: Show what a name or a problem is when the mouse rests on it
check_box.name: hover_cards
check_box.tool_tip: A card with the declaration, its documentation and any problem there

spinner.name: hover_delay
spinner.tool_tip: How long the mouse rests on a name before its card shows

check_box.label: Yank, delete and put use the system clipboard
check_box.name: vim_clipboard
check_box.tool_tip: As vim's clipboard=unnamed: y, d, x and p with no register named go by the clipboard other programs share; off, they stay in the editor, and only "+ and "* reach the clipboard. A named register, "a, never does.

panel.label: Build
panel.name: build_tab

check_box.label: Check scripts for errors before saving
check_box.name: preflight
check_box.tool_tip: The analyzers look a script over before every save; errors they find hold the save until it is asked for again

check_box.label: Make safe fixes when saving
check_box.name: fix_on_save
check_box.tool_tip: The fixes that change nothing a script does -- an unused local marked unused, a misspelt directive -- are made before it is saved, as one step to undo. Nothing is taken out: a function nothing calls, or code that can never run, is left for Fix All

check_box.label: Format scripts when saving
check_box.name: format_on_save
check_box.tool_tip: The formatter runs over the whole script before it is saved, as one step to undo

check_box.label: Take the blanks off the ends of lines when saving
check_box.name: trim_on_save
check_box.tool_tip: Spaces and tabs at the end of every line go before the script is saved, as one step to undo

line_editor.name: external_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: The command Edit in External Editor runs: the program, then "%s" where the script's file goes. Empty, the system's editor for text

button.label: Browse...
button.name: external_browse
button.tool_tip: Choose the program; the command is made from it

button.label: More Scripting Settings...
button.name: scripting_settings
button.tool_tip: VS Code integration and syncing over a WebSocket, in the viewer's scripting settings

check_box.label: Include from the object and your inventory
check_box.name: preproc_world
check_box.tool_tip: An #include or a require may name a script or a notecard in the object the script is in, or anywhere in your inventory. Off, a script opened from somebody else's object cannot pull your own scripts into itself, and only the folders on disk below are looked in

check_box.label: Include files from folders on disk
check_box.name: preproc_disk
check_box.tool_tip: An #include may name a file in the folders below, looked for in order after the object and inventory unless the order below says otherwise. Nothing else on the disk is read, but where a .lslrc or .luaurc on disk points

scroll_list.name: include_folders
scroll_list.tool_tip: The folders on disk an #include is read from, looked in from the top

button.label: Remove
button.name: remove_folder
button.tool_tip: Look in the chosen folder no more

panel.text: Where an include is looked for, first to last:

scroll_list.name: include_order
scroll_list.tool_tip: The places an #include or require is looked for, the first that has it winning; a place unticked is not looked in

button.label: Up
button.name: order_up
button.tool_tip: Look in the chosen place sooner

button.label: Down
button.name: order_down
button.tool_tip: Look in the chosen place later

check_box.label: Preprocess every script when saving
check_box.name: preproc_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Every script goes through the preprocessor when saved, with its source kept in the envelope Firestorm's uses; a script already in that envelope always does, whatever this says

check_box.label: Switch statements
check_box.name: preproc_switch
check_box.tool_tip: LSL gains a switch statement, turned into jumps before compiling

check_box.label: Lazy lists
check_box.name: preproc_lazy
check_box.tool_tip: Writing list[i] in LSL reads an element, as Firestorm's preprocessor allows

check_box.label: Break, continue, &= |= ^= and inline
check_box.name: preproc_extensions
check_box.tool_tip: LSL gains break and continue in loops, the &= |= ^= <<= >>= assignments and inline functions, written out before compiling

check_box.label: Compress the output
check_box.name: preproc_compress
check_box.tool_tip: What is compiled has its comments and spare spaces taken out, which makes for a smaller asset

check_box.label: Optimize LSL: fold constants, drop unused code
check_box.name: preproc_optimize
check_box.tool_tip: Constants folded, unused code dropped, and every change reported among the problems; the compile target chooses the arithmetic

check_box.label: Shrink names
check_box.name: preproc_shrink
check_box.tool_tip: Global names made as short as they can be in what is compiled; the source keeps the real ones

check_box.label: Join string constants
check_box.name: preproc_addstrings
check_box.tool_tip: Adjacent string constants joined into one, which LSL does not do on its own

check_box.label: Inline functions called once
check_box.name: preproc_inline
check_box.tool_tip: A user function called from one place is put in that place and the function dropped

panel.text: Defined for every script, one to a line (NAME or NAME=value):

text_editor.name: preproc_defines
text_editor.tool_tip: Macros the preprocessor defines before every script: DEBUG alone is 1, and VERSION=2 is 2; a script's own #define or #undef has the last word

panel.label: Lints
panel.name: lints_tab

scroll_list.name: lints_lsl
scroll_list.tool_tip: What the LSL checker warns of: tick On to be told, Error to have it count as an error, which holds a save when scripts are checked before saving

button.label: Defaults
button.name: lints_defaults
button.tool_tip: Every lint on, as a warning, and SLua checked nonstrict, as the grid compiles, by the old type solver

combo_box.name: luau_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: How strictly a script is type checked where neither a --!strict comment nor a .luaurc says

combo_box.name: luau_solver
combo_box.tool_tip: Which of Luau's two type solvers checks SLua scripts. The new one works out more of what a script's types are, and finds some mistakes the old one misses and misses some it finds; it can take longer, and some of its messages are shown in English whatever the viewer's language

scroll_list.name: lints_luau
scroll_list.tool_tip: What the SLua linter warns of: tick On to be told, Error to have it count as an error, which holds a save when scripts are checked before saving

panel.text: A .luaurc beside a script overrides these for that script, lint by lint and its mode.

panel.label: Snippets
panel.name: snippets_tab

combo_box.name: snippet_language
combo_box.tool_tip: Whose snippets are shown: LSL's or SLua's

scroll_list.name: snippet_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Your snippets, then the viewer's, which are copied to be changed

button.label: New
button.name: snippet_new
button.tool_tip: A snippet of your own, to fill in

button.label: Copy
button.name: snippet_copy
button.tool_tip: A copy of the chosen snippet among your own, the viewer's too, to change

button.label: Delete
button.name: snippet_delete
button.tool_tip: The chosen snippet of your own taken away

line_editor.name: snippet_name
line_editor.tool_tip: What the Insert menu and the completion list call it

line_editor.name: snippet_prefix
line_editor.tool_tip: What is typed for completion to offer it

line_editor.name: snippet_detail
line_editor.tool_tip: A line about it, shown beside it

panel.text: ${1:text}, ${2} and $1 are the places Tab goes through, in order; $0 is where the caret ends.

button.label: Edit as XML...
button.name: snippet_xml
button.tool_tip: Your snippets file, opened in the studio as the XML it is

panel.label: Templates
panel.name: templates_tab
panel.text: What a script made in the studio's explorer starts with, to be saved; empty, the grid's own.

code_editor.name: template_lsl
code_editor.tool_tip: What a new LSL script starts with; empty, the grid's own

code_editor.name: template_slua
code_editor.tool_tip: What a new SLua script starts with; empty, the grid's own

button.label: Cancel
button.name: cancel
button.tool_tip: Every color and setting back to what it was when this window opened
